shared_elements: low-relief figure carved on the face of a standing monolithic pillar/block
schematic body forms rendered as raised, rounded ridges
justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces carry a single schematic figure rendered in shallow raised relief on the face of an upright monolith, with limbs/details reduced to smooth ridges. What is actually depicted differs entirely: A is an anthropomorphic figure with a face, arms, concentric disc motifs on the chest and a horizontal belt, while B is a single quadruped animal in strict profile with no accompanying motifs or human features.
